title: City Views | Rooftop Deck | Fire Pit + Grill
description:
Unforgettable Nashville awaits! Stay in this exquisite 4 bedroom house at The Lucy, featuring a private rooftop with a fire pit and amazing skyline views. Located a mere 3 miles from Downtown Broadway, East Nashville, and Germantown, this home provides the perfect base for exploring Nashville's music, food, and culture.

The space
★Highlights★
- Rooftop with fire pit + Skyline Views + Gas Grill
- 3 miles from downtown
- Professionally Decorated
- Fully Stocked Chef's Kitchen

★★Must Climb Stairs★★

Layout
★Level One★
2 Car Garage 2  (Trucks/SUVs longer than 21’6” will NOT fit in garage)
Laundry Room - Full Sized Washer + Dryer (pods and dryer sheets included)
Bedroom One - Queen Bed, Smart TV + Full ensuite Bathroom with Shower/Tub, Room Darkening Drapes

★Level Two★
Bedroom Two - Queen Bed, Smart TV + Room Darkening Drapes
Bedroom Three - Queen over Queen Custom, Built-in Bunkbed, Smart TV + Room Darkening Drapes
Hallway Bathroom - Full Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo 
Bedroom Four - Queen Bed, Smart TV, Full ensuite Bathroom with Double Sinks and Walk-in Shower + Room Darkening Drapes

★Level Three★
Kitchen - Fully Stocked, Gourmet Kitchen w/Island Seating + Dining Table + Coffee/Tea Station
Half Bathroom
Living Room with Queen Sofa Sleeper + Smart TV + Views of Downtown Nashville

★Level Four★
Rooftop - Dining Area, Soft Seating, Gas Grill + Fire Pit + Skyline Views of the City

Guest access
Guests have access to entire home except locked storage closets.

Other things to note
★★Must Climb Stairs★★ There are 3 FULL Flights of stairs in the house.
